original_test_intent: Validate the platform's x8-device SDDC correction path on every approved memory controller using a confirmed x8 DIMM population, with correct slot attribution, continued operation and no front-panel or DIMM lightpath fault assertion.
original_method: A qualified operator powers down and installs the approved x8 DIMM in the specified population under ESD controls, verifies device width and topology after boot, then an FAE configures BIOS/ITP and performs one x8sddc injection per authorized controller tuple. Evidence must distinguish x8 SDDC from generic CE, correlate the physical slot, confirm no-light behavior and restore both population and settings.
manual_activity: A qualified hardware operator must power down, install and later restore the approved x8 module/population, inspect seating and lamps; an FAE selects the mapped tuple and performs the injection. Software inventory cannot replace module-width and seating confirmation.
required_inputs: Approved x8 DRAM-device DIMM PN/revision/rank and population recipe
Power-off/ESD/removal/installation procedure and known-good restoration configuration
Supported ITP/CScripts build/hash and x8sddc signature/semantics
Windows/BMC/UEFI oracle, indicator applicability and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Remove power as specified, discharge and use ESD controls before touching memory
Verify keying, orientation, slot, seating and supported population; never force a module
Preserve baseline logs/configuration and validate topology before one injection per target
Stop for training failure, wrong width/slot, uncorrectable severity, crash, lamp assertion or persistent memory error
No automatic retry; restore hardware/settings only under the approved procedure
agent_execution_scope: Collect inventory/topology and read-only OS/BMC/UEFI evidence after operator confirmation
Do not open the chassis, install/remove DIMMs, alter BIOS, select a tuple, inject, reset/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve x8 module/population and controller/rank coverage
Define authoritative proof of x8 device width and exact x8sddc response
Reconcile Windows with dmesg and specify BMC/UEFI slot fields plus lamp applicability
Approve hardware/BIOS restoration, recovery and final verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record PN/device-width evidence and before/after population photos, validate trained topology and `mc.dimminfo()`, inject one x8sddc event per approved controller tuple, correlate x8-specific correction and slot identity, photograph off indicators, then restore/diff population, BIOS and memory health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds proof that the physical configuration actually exercises x8-device correction and a controlled restoration path.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic CE/SDDC log from an unknown DIMM width does not test x8 SDDC; software-only evidence misses installation/seating coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong or unsupported memory population can prevent training, damage connectors or change channel topology; injection may produce unexpected uncorrectable behavior.

project_override_considerations: This hybrid physical/package case requires explicit owner confirmation; neither module handling nor injection is agent-direct. Missing approved x8 hardware or safe restoration blocks execution, not review progress.

Package hash, full topology and controller-to-tuple/rank coverage map
Per-target x8sddc transcript plus authoritative Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI slot evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: No x8 DIMM part, supported population or proof method is defined; Memory controller 1~N is reduced to one rank-0 DIMM tuple without a coverage matrix; Windows is paired with dmesg, and UEFI/indicator applicability is conditional but unspecified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The x8 SDDC purpose and injector are identifiable. Approved module/population, package, map, oracle and restoration are expected inputs, so the run is gated rather than irreducibly blocked.

review_improvement: This review prevents an unknown-width DIMM or generic CE record from being credited as x8 SDDC and adds the physical configuration evidence required to distinguish it from the completed x4 variant.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDDC capability depends on DRAM device width and platform ECC organization; a DIMM marketed by capacity/rank alone does not prove x8 devices. The installation therefore changes the test precondition and memory topology and must be evidenced independently of Cscript output. A rank-0 tuple also does not automatically cover every controller. Since Windows is specified, the software oracle must use the approved Windows RAS interface, while BMC/UEFI and no-light evidence establish serviceability behavior. These resolvable inputs make REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION appropriate.
